switcher.title: Your clubs
switcher.subtitle: The lobby, history and stats follow the club you pick.

playing.title: Playing now
playing.emptyBody: Start one and everyone sees it here, live.
playing.yourInvite: You're invited. Confirm with your PIN

needs.title: Waiting for you
needs.inviteBody: Accept with your PIN before the invite expires
needs.verifyBody: Played {{date}}. Your PIN verifies your seat

online.title: At the club
online.nobody: Nobody else is online right now
online.label: {{name}}, online

new.title: New game
new.subtitle: Tap 4 players: the first two are Team A, the next two Team B
new.normalHint: Each player accepts on their own phone, and each team confirms rounds with their PIN.
new.ghostHint: Pick the players and play. You enter all the scores. Counts in stats right away. Guests welcome.
new.guestsDropped: Guests were removed: verified games are members only.
new.guestHint: Guests can play in Start now games
new.guestInvalid: Use a new name of 1 to 40 characters.
new.full: All four places are taken. Tap a player to free a place.

issue.needFour: Pick four players, two per team.
issue.duplicate: A player can only take one seat.
issue.guestsNeedGhost: Guests can only play in Start now games.
issue.hostMustPlay: Take a seat yourself to host a verified game.

new.ghostHintConfirm: Pick the players and play. You enter all the scores. Counts in stats once the players confirm with their PIN. Guests welcome.
new.aloneTitle: You're the only player so far
new.aloneBody: Add the other players once, then pick them here for every game.
new.aloneAsk: Ask an admin to add the other players.

invite.title: Waiting for players
invite.subtitle: The game starts as soon as all four are in
invite.timeUpHost: The invite window closed. Swap a player to restart the clock, or start now without waiting.
invite.declinedBanner: {{name}} declined. Swap in someone else or start now.
invite.youreIn: You're in. Waiting for the others.
invite.declineBody: The host will be told and can invite someone else to your seat.
invite.swapSubtitle: The new player gets an invite and the 10-minute clock restarts.
invite.swapNone: Every member is already at this table.
invite.ghostBody: The game starts now and you enter all the scores. It counts in stats right away.
invite.cancelBody: All invites are withdrawn. This can't be undone.
invite.expiredBody: Not everyone confirmed within 10 minutes. Start a new game when the table is ready.
invite.cancelledBody: The host called it off before it started.
invite.overBody: You'll find it in the history.
invite.ghostBodyConfirm: The game starts now without waiting. Anyone who already accepted counts as confirmed; everyone else confirms the result later with their PIN. Until then it doesn't count toward rankings.

home.quickBody: Just add up the scores, nothing is saved
